name: backup-review
title: Backup assurance review
for_each: select id,code,name from clients order by code

sections.title: Recorded backup and restore evidence
sections.sql: select code,name,device,state,last_result,last_success,restore_state,last_restore,restore_due from v_morning where client_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select a.code,a.name,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status,a.evidence from actions a join jobs j on j.id=a.job_id where j.client_id=$1 order by a.due_on

name: restore-record
title: Restore exercise record
for_each: select id,code,name from jobs order by code

sections.title: Exercises recorded
sections.sql: select tested_at,outcome,recovery_minutes,evidence,actor from restore_tests where job_id=$1 order by tested_at desc
